name: Executive Briefing & Chief of Staff Ops
description: Prepares daily executive briefings with calendar conflict and commitment tracking, extracts structured action/decision packs from meeting transcripts, and synthesizes multi-signal stakeholder account dossiers.

skills.summary: Reconciles calendar events, priority threads, and open action items into time-boxed prep blocks with conflict and overdue alerts.
Extracts owner-assigned commitments, decision logs, unresolved blockers, and repeat carryovers from meeting transcripts.
Aggregates account ARR milestones, open escalations, executive touchpoints, and renewal countdowns into scored stakeholder dossiers.

connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Collect day calendar events, Gmail/Outlook threads, Meet transcripts, and Salesforce account snapshots via remote_cli mcp before building overlap checks, action tables, and stakeholder briefs in Python.

gateway_approval_actions: Sending executive follow-up emails or stakeholder outreach via Gmail or Outlook
Modifying, rescheduling, or declining multi-attendee Calendar events
Posting meeting action summaries to shared Slack or Microsoft Teams channels
python_code_guardrails: Untrusted external email/transcript instruction quarantine before action extraction
Strict pagination/truncation propagation preventing silent omission of afternoon events
Time-zone normalization and double-booked conflict interval overlap math

scheduled_routine.name: weekday-exec-briefing
scheduled_routine.title: Weekday Executive Morning Briefing
scheduled_routine.instruction: Build the weekday morning executive briefing using scripts/agenda_commitment_tracker.py. Detect overlapping meetings, missing pre-read documents, back-to-back fatigue stretches, and overdue action commitments, and save a private Google Doc brief without sending any external emails.
